# Install and load packgages

```{r}
#| warning: false

.packages <- c(
    "renv",
    "dplyr",
    "purrr",
    "here",
    "tidyr",
    "magrittr",
    "devtools",
    # Plot
    "ComplexHeatmap",
    "MetBrewer",
    "ggplot2",
    "patchwork",
    "cowplot",
    # Single Cell
    "Seurat",
    "SeuratData",
    # Single Cell plotting
    "SCpubr",
    # Python alternatives
    "reticulate"
)
# Install
.installed_packages <- .packages %in%
    rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(.installed_packages == F)) {
    install.packages(.packages[!.installed_packages])
}
# Load
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    invisible(lapply(.packages, library, character.only = T))
})
```

# Set working directory

```{r}
directory <- here::here()
```

# Load dataset

```{r}
# Install
SeuratData::InstallData("bmcite")

bm <- SeuratData::LoadData(ds = "bmcite")
```

# Process and plot

```{r}
Seurat::DefaultAssay(bm) <- 'RNA'

bm <- Seurat::NormalizeData(bm) %>%
  Seurat::FindVariableFeatures() %>%
  Seurat::ScaleData() %>%
  Seurat::RunPCA()

Seurat::DefaultAssay(bm) <- 'ADT'

Seurat::VariableFeatures(bm) <- rownames(bm[["ADT"]])

bm <- Seurat::NormalizeData(
  bm,
  normalization.method = 'CLR',
  # Normalize within cells
  margin = 2
) %>%
  Seurat::ScaleData() %>%
  Seurat::RunPCA(reduction.name = 'apca')

# Calculates the closest neighbors in the dataset
bm <- Seurat::FindMultiModalNeighbors(
  bm,
  reduction.list = list("pca", "apca"),
  dims.list = list(1:30, 1:18),
  modality.weight.name = "RNA.weight"
)

bm %<>%
  Seurat::RunUMAP(
    nn.name = "weighted.nn",
    reduction.name = "wnn.umap",
    reduction.key = "wnnUMAP_"
  ) %>%
  Seurat::FindClusters(
    graph.name = "wsnn",
    algorithm = 3,
    resolution = 2,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

# Plot
.p1 <- .dim_umap_scpub(
  SEURAT_OBJECT = bm,
  POINT_SIZE = 0.5,
  LABEL_SIZE = 5,
  LABEL = TRUE,
  REDUCTION = "wnn.umap",
  PALETTE = "Archambault"
) +
  Seurat::NoLegend()

.p2 <- .dim_umap_scpub(
  SEURAT_OBJECT = bm,
  POINT_SIZE = 0.5,
  LABEL_SIZE = 5,
  LABEL = TRUE,
  GROUP_BY = "celltype.l2",
  REDUCTION = "wnn.umap",
  PALETTE = "Archambault"
) +
  Seurat::NoLegend()

fs::dir_create(
  path = file.path(
    c("outputs", "plots"),
    "05_wnn"
  )
)

.p1 + .p2

# Save
# .tiff_pdf_plot(
#   PLOT = .p1 + .p2,
#   HEIGHT = 6,
#   WIDTH = 8,

#     directory,
#     "plots",
#     "05_wnn"
#   ),
#   FILENAME = paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y_%b_%d"), "_umap_wnn_cellTypes")
# )

# RNA and protein dimensional reduction
bm %<>%
  Seurat::RunUMAP(
    reduction = 'pca',
    dims = 1:30,
    assay = 'RNA',
    reduction.name = 'rna.umap',
    reduction.key = 'rnaUMAP_'
  )

bm %<>%
  Seurat::RunUMAP(
    reduction = 'apca',
    dims = 1:18,
    assay = 'ADT',
    reduction.name = 'adt.umap',
    reduction.key = 'adtUMAP_'
  )

.p1 <- .dim_umap_scpub(
  SEURAT_OBJECT = bm,
  REDUCTION = "rna.umap",
  POINT_SIZE = 0.5,
  LABEL_SIZE = 5,
  LABEL = TRUE,
  GROUP_BY = "celltype.l2",
  PALETTE = "Archambault"
) +
  Seurat::NoLegend()

.p2 <- .dim_umap_scpub(
  SEURAT_OBJECT = bm,
  POINT_SIZE = 0.5,
  LABEL_SIZE = 5,
  LABEL = TRUE,
  GROUP_BY = "celltype.l2",
  REDUCTION = "adt.umap",
  PALETTE = "Archambault"
) +
  Seurat::NoLegend()

.p1 + .p2
```
